connector.name: Openchargemap MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Find EV charging stations, detail, and reliability check-ins via the global Open Charge Map.
connector.summary: Hosted at openchargemap.caseyjhand.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package openchargemap-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cyanheads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: OPENCHARGEMAP_API_KEY
env.description: Open Charge Map API key, sent as the X-API-Key header on every request. Free instant signup at openchargemap.org.

env.name: OPENCHARGEMAP_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the OCM API base URL (default https://api.openchargemap.io/v3). For a private mirror or testing.

env.name: OPENCHARGEMAP_REFERENCE_REFRESH
env.description: When true, refresh reference data from the live /referencedata endpoint at startup, falling back to the bundled snapshot on failure.

env.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
